name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hup hi
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit (InitStatesLength hi) (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hup) $ InitStatesNodup hi, ?_⟩
  cases InitStatesUpdated hi
  cases UpdateStatesUpdated hup
  delta updatedStates
  rw [updatedStatesComm]
  apply updatedStatesUpdate $ UpdateStatesLength hup
  apply updatedStatesDefMonotone
  apply UpdateStatesDefined' hup
  simp [List.unzip_zip, UpdateStatesLength hup, InitStatesLength hi]
  intro _ hk hk'
  cases InitStatesNotDefined hi _ hk' ▸ UpdateStatesDefined hup _ hk

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x
  have hle := ‹OpensMeasurableSpace Y›.borel_le
  have hc : Continuous (⟪f ·, f x⟫_ℝ) := by fun_prop
  apply inner_self_eq_zero'.1 $ congrFun ((hc.ae_eq_iff_eq μ continuous_zero).1 $ ae_eq_of_ae_eq_trim (hm := hle) ?_) x
  letI := borel Y
  haveI : BorelSpace Y := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts $ μ.trim hle := ⟨fun K hK ↦ trim_measurableSet_eq hle hK.measurableSet ▸ hK.measure_lt_top⟩
  exact ae_eq_zero_of_integral_contDiff_smul_eq_zero hc.locallyIntegrable fun g hgs hgc ↦ integral_trim hle (hgs.continuous.mul hc).stronglyMeasurable ▸ by simpa only [inner_smul_right', Pi.mul_apply] using hg _ $ .smul_right ⟨hgs, hgc⟩ contDiff_const

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA₂ : ContDiff ℝ 2 A := hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hA₃ : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hEs := fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) (i := j) hA₃ t
  have hEd := fun j => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j)
  have hBs := magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) A hA₃
  have hJd := hJ.differentiable (WithTop.coe_ne_zero.2 ENat.top_ne_zero)
  have hg := congrArg (∂[i] · x)
    (funext fun x => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t x).1)
  unfold Space.div at hg
  rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
    fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt)] at hg
  conv at hg =>
    rhs
    rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
    simp only [div_eq_inv_mul]
    rw [fderiv_const_mul ((LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space hJd t) x)]
  simp only [_root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] at hg
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, t]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time hA₂ _),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq, ((((HasFDerivAt.fun_sum fun j _ => (Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hBs (j, i)) x t).hasFDerivAt).const_mul _).fun_sub
    ((LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (c := 𝓕.c) hJd x i t).hasFDerivAt.const_mul _))).fderiv]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, ← Time.deriv_eq]
  simp only [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (hBs _), time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ hA₂,
    fun j => Space.fun_deriv_sub (u := j) _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i), Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    fun j => congrFun (Space.deriv_commute (u := j) (v := i) _ (hEs j)) x]
  rw [hg, FreeSpace.c_sq, mul_comm 𝓕.ε₀ 𝓕.μ₀]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev, one_mul, mul_sub, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let m := LinearMap.mul ℂ 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  suffices h : (m.comp (m.flip c)).compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap.comp timeOrderF) =
      m.compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap.comp ((m c).comp timeOrderF)) from
    LinearMap.congr_fun₂ h a b
  apply LinearMap.ext_basis ofCrAnListFBasis ofCrAnListFBasis
  intro x y
  change ι 𝓣ᶠ(_ * _ * _) = ι (_ * 𝓣ᶠ(_ * _))
  simp only [c, ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF,
    map_smul, mul_smul_comm]
  obtain ⟨l, r, f⟩ : ∃ l r : 𝓕.WickAlgebra, ∀ z : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp,
      (∀ c ∈ z, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) →
      ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (x ++ z ++ y))) = l * ι (ofCrAnListF z) * r := by
    exact ⟨_, _, fun z hz => by
      rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_eq_list (h := hz)]
      simp only [ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul]
      exact @mul_assoc 𝓕.WickAlgebra _ _ _ _⟩
  trans crAnTimeOrderSign (x ++ φ :: ψ :: y) •
    (l * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * r)
  · rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
    simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc,
      map_sub, map_smul, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
      timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
    rw [f _ ?_, f _ ?_]
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, smul_sub, smul_comm]
    all_goals simp [*]
  rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ),
    mul_assoc]
  have w := f [] (List.forall_mem_nil _)
  simp at w
  rw [← w]
  by_cases q : 𝓕.crAnStatistics φ = 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ
  · simp only [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ q.symm]
  · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic q, zero_mul, smul_zero]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  let lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der
  all_goals clear_value lc
  simp_all
  all_goals simp_all only [true_implies, body_let, body_case]
  case' app | tapp => cases lc
  all_goals aesop (config := {enableSimp := false}) (add safe [cases (cases_patterns := [Value (.inl _), Value (.inr _)]) Value, destruct Typing.canonical_form_abs, destruct Typing.canonical_form_tabs, forward Typing.canonical_form_sum, Value], 90% Red)

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => use a₂, h₂, ParallelReduction.refl a₂
  all_goals cases h₂
  case' par.par iha ihb _ _ ha'' hb'' =>
    obtain ⟨_, _, _⟩ := iha ha''
    obtain ⟨_, _, _⟩ := ihb hb''
    constructor
    constructor <;> apply ParallelReduction.par <;> assumption
  case' par.red_I | red_I.par =>
    cases I_irreducible _ ‹_›
    constructor
    constructor <;> first | apply ParallelReduction.red_I | assumption
  case' par.red_K | red_K.par =>
    obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ‹_›
    constructor
    constructor <;> first | apply ParallelReduction.red_K | assumption
  case' par.red_S | red_S.par =>
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ‹_›
    constructor
    constructor <;> first
    | apply ParallelReduction.red_S
    | apply ParallelReduction.par <;> apply ParallelReduction.par <;> assumption
  all_goals
    constructor
    constructor
    constructor
    constructor <;> assumption

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists ChoiceBisim, .choice h
  rintro _ _ (h | h) μ
  all_goals
    apply (Bisimilarity.isBisimulation _ _ h μ).imp
    all_goals
    intro f s t
  iterate 2
    cases t
    exact (f _ ‹_›).imp fun _ => And.imp Tr.choiceL .bisim
    exact ⟨s, Tr.choiceR ‹_›, .bisim (.refl _)⟩
  all_goals exact (f _ t).imp fun _ => And.imp id .bisim

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  obtain ⟨⟨g', hmem⟩, _, hg⟩ : d_fw ∈ (_ : Set ℕ) :=
    Nat.sInf_mem (Set.univ_nonempty.image _)
  have hΔ : hammingDist f g' ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    let B := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
    rw [hammingDist, ← Fintype.card_subtype, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    have hs : {x | f x ≠ g' x} ⊆ Set.range (fun z : B × Fin (2 ^ steps) => qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, i.isLt.trans (Nat.lt_of_add_right_lt h_ℓ_add_R_rate)⟩ steps (lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le _ _ _ h_i_add_steps) z.1 z.2) := by
      intro x hx
      exact ⟨(⟨_, x, rfl, hx⟩, _),
        (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl⟩
    calc _ ≤ _ := Set.ncard_le_ncard hs
         _ ≤ _ := Finite.card_range_le _
         _ = _ := by rw [Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_fin, show Nat.card B = d_fw from hg]
  have h3 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt))
  simp (disch := omega) only [Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, Nat.mul_assoc,
    ← Nat.sub_add_comm, Nat.add_sub_add_right] at h3
  exact (mul_le_mul_left' ((distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g' hmem).trans
    (ENat.coe_le_coe.2 hΔ)) 2).trans_lt (ENat.coe_lt_coe.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le h3))

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  have h_eval_qMap (b : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1
      (Nat.succ_le_of_lt i.isLt) (fiberMap b) y ⟨b, rfl⟩)).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h_eval_qMap
  have h_fiber_diff : x₁.val = 1 + x₀.val := by
    simp only [x₀, x₁, fiberMap,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (Nat.succ_le_of_lt i.isLt), Fin2ToF2,
      Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add,
      Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  change P_i.eval x₀.val * _ + P_i.eval x₁.val * _ = _
  simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
        h_eval_qMap, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, P_i, x₀, x₁]
  calc
    _ = (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
      rw [h_fiber_diff]
      ring1
    _ = _ := by
      simp +singlePass only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
        intermediateEvaluationPoly]
      simp only [Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum,
        Polynomial.eval_C_mul, Finset.mul_sum,
        ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, new_coeffs, add_mul, mul_assoc]
      rfl

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  apply Nat.le_induction
  ·
    intro u hp
    simp +singlePass only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation, prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F)
      (fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e),
      Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hp
    have hu : finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) = u := (piFinTwoEquiv _).injective rfl
    exact hu ▸ hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hp
  · intro n hn ih u hp
    simp +singlePass only [multilinearCombine_recursive_form] at hp
    erw [prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun
      (multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close MC u e)] at hp
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA
    apply h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ n) Nat.one_le_two_pow
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le (prob_R_star_gt_threshold MC u e hp)
    exact Pr_le_Pr_of_implies ($ᵖ F) _ _ (fun r hr =>
      correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor MC ih u ⟨r, hr⟩)

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, he⟩ := Set.finite_univ.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem (f := fun n (k : Fin 4) => (⟨u (n + k), hB (n + k)⟩ : Set.Icc B T)) fun _ => Set.mem_univ _
  have hp (m : ℕ) : u (i + m) = u (j + m) := by
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h m ih =>
      by_cases hm : m < 4
      · exact congrArg Subtype.val $ congrFun he ⟨m, hm⟩
      · have hprev k (hk : 0 < k ∧ k ≤ m) : u (i + m - k) = u (j + m - k) := by simpa only [Nat.add_sub_assoc hk.2] using ih _ $ Nat.sub_lt (by omega) hk.1
        exact Int.cast_injective $ by rw [(hu (i + m) $ by omega).1, (hu (j + m) $ by omega).1, hprev 1, hprev 2, hprev 3, hprev 4] <;> omega
  exact ⟨i, j - i, by omega, fun n hn => by convert (hp (n - i)).symm using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> omega⟩

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  apply Nat.mul_right_cancel Nat.two_pos
  rw [Nat.pow_pred_mul Fintype.card_pos, Nat.mul_comm P.card, ← Fintype.card_set]
  apply (Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq ?_).mp
  · intro Q hQ hPQ
    apply Finset.Subset.antisymm hPQ
    simp only [Set.Intersecting, Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, Finset.mem_coe] at hQ
    grind [Finset.subset_iff]
  · simpa only [Set.Intersecting, Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty] using hPP

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h i
  simp only [hrelation, hdigits_to_num, ite_mul, Finset.sum_ite, Finset.filter_eq', Finset.filter_ne',
    Finset.mem_univ, if_true, Finset.sum_singleton, Finset.sum_erase_eq_sub] at h
  have hS := Finset.dvd_sum (s := .univ) fun j _ => h.1.2 j
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Fin.sum_const] at hS
  refine (((Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one (n := 10)).mpr rfl).pow_right (n := i.1)).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right ?_
  exact (Int.dvd_sub (Int.dvd_sub hS (Int.dvd_add (h.1.2 i) (h.2.2 i))) (Int.dvd_mul_right 7 (∑ j, d j * 10 ^ j.1))).trans (dvd_of_eq (by ring1))
